pinout.calibration: Grid calibrated to top-view 1..63 numbering and standard 2.54 mm spacing. CAD STEP supplies outer geometry but no exposed hole-center entities.
pinout.connectivity: Five rows per terminal column are grouped; rails are independent segments split at column 32/33. This electrical connectivity follows standard half-size breadboard construction and the supplied image.
pinout.verification: Physical pin positions and internal metal-strip continuity require a contact-level CAD model or continuity measurement.

claimNote: This part provides 630 terminal-strip access points and 252 rail access points; standard board families commonly advertise 830 holes, but this reference image/model has 63 positions per rail row.
